description: Generated clients have a `paginate_<operation>` method for each operation with the `@paginated` trait, which lazily iterates its pages and, when the trait names items, its items. Pagination ends at a page with no token or, unless `stop_on_same_token=False` is passed, at a page whose token equals the one its request sent. An operation input member whose Python name would be `stop_on_same_token` is generated as `stop_on_same_token_`, adding more underscores if a sibling already uses that name.
